description: This file contains test fixture classes and setup code for Orleans-based tests involving Azure Service Bus and Event Hub, including collection definitions and a base fixture for Event Hub integration tests.

classes.name: DefaultClusterTestCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring a default Orleans cluster setup, sharing a single cluster instance.

classes.name: TestEnvironmentFixtureCollection
classes.description: Defines a test collection for tests requiring shared environment configuration, including Azure Service Bus and Event Hub setup.

classes.name: BaseEventHubTestClusterFixture
classes.description: Abstract base fixture for Event Hub integration tests, ensuring connectivity and stream queue initialization.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Checks preconditions for Event Hub connectivity, throws exception if not met.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture asynchronously, including waiting for stream queue measurements.
